messages:
Ivy S: FYI starting Equinox (cust) LoRA onboarding. quick sanity smoke shows fractional cents dropped from invoice lines under long context. uploaded evalpack: equinox-invoice-quick-v2 :link:
Rohan: paste one failing example?
Ivy S: prompt 021: 'Total payable: $1,234.56' -> sometimes returns '1,234' or '1234' (drops .56) when conversation >2500 tokens.
Marta: did their finetune include a custom tokenizer or token patch?
Ivy S: yes, they used equinox_tok_patch.json during finetune but merge applied LoRA without rebasing token ids to our base tokenizer.
Rohan: run tokenmap diff: `python3 tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/equinox_tok_patch.json`
Rohan: diff snippet shows punctuation and digit tokens moved (e.g., `".": 56 -> 512`, `"," : 17 -> 210`, `"$": 345 -> 1023`).
Marta: that will misalign embedding indices. LoRA weight keys referencing embedding rows will point at wrong tokens. Use `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py` to remap LoRA to target tokenizer before quant.
Ivy S: plan: (1) fp16 baseline, (2) int4 without remap, (3) int4 with remap. I'll run quick-eval on staging slot.
EvalBot: quick-eval job queued (id ej-88001) on dedicated-gpu-2. ETA ~10m.
Rohan: also add a tiny smoke assertion in tests/smoke/currency_cents.test to check generated numbers contain cents `\d+\.\d{2}`.
EvalBot: job finished. summary metrics: fp16 (no quant) cents preserved 99.0%, int4 w/o remap 70.8%, int4 with remap 95.7%. logs: /mnt/results/ej-88001/summary.json
Ivy S: clear signal that remap recovers most regressions. I'd like to make remap automatic when tokenmaps differ and add a `--skip-rebase` opt-out.
Marta: agree. add pipeline step: detect tokenizer mismatch, generate mapping, apply to LoRA embedding keys, then run quick smoke. include note in docs/onboarding.md.
Ivy S: opening PR with script + test. tagging @Marta for review. ops-bot, please reserve dedicated-gpu-2 for full smokepack 2025-07-02T02:00:00Z-2025-07-02T04:00:00Z.
ops-bot: reservation confirmed for dedicated-gpu-2 2025-07-02T02:00:00Z to 2025-07-02T04:00:00Z  reservation id res-80021
Rohan: nice catch. adding a release checklist item: "run tokenmap diff for any customer tokenizer and rebase LoRA if different" :thumbsup:
